title: DR1 heads the notification list "My notifications"; the frontend heads it "Your notifications".

finding.frontend: The list is introduced by a second-level heading reading "Your notifications" (src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/dashboard/copy/copy.en.js:8). The breadcrumb that links back here from the delete and cancel-amendment pages uses the same words, from a separate shared copy file (src/server/app/shared/copy.en.js:15), so the label is written twice.
finding.prototype: DR1 heads the same block "My notifications" (app/views/dashboard.html:80).
finding.difference: Change the heading to "My notifications" in the English and Welsh copy files for the dashboard feature. Decide at the same time whether the breadcrumb label in src/server/app/shared/copy.en.js:15 follows the heading, so the two do not drift apart.
finding.falsifiedBy: Finding "Your notifications" as the list heading in DR1's root dashboard view.
finding.correction: Nothing to correct. All three citations are exact to the line, including the shared one — src/server/app/shared/copy.en.js:15 is serviceHome: 'Your notifications', and the breadcrumb rendered from it is visible on both the delete and cancel-amendment pictures, which is what makes the drift warning in difference worth keeping. Both headings appear in their page models at the same level.
